text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with BTC showing slightly steeper weakness at -1.5%, signaling mild profit-taking or caution among larger holders. The Fear & Greed Index at 12 (Extreme Fear) and deteriorating by 20 points over a week reflects sustained pessimism, though the $78B in daily volume and stable 58.3% BTC dominance suggest the market has not panicked into a rout. Smaller altcoins like SOL are holding better than the majors, which often appears when fear suppresses speculative liquidations but selective conviction remains in certain ecosystems.
